tools.name: search_startups
tools.description: Search ShowMRR startups by name or keyword. Returns each match with its current MRR, whether that MRR is verified or self-reported, and a link to its public ShowMRR page.

tools.name: get_startup
tools.description: Get one startup's public ShowMRR profile: current MRR, growth, verification status and source of the figure, and links.

tools.name: get_mrr_history
tools.description: Daily MRR history of one startup. Each point says whether ShowMRR read it from a connected payment provider or it was self-reported.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Startups ranked by current MRR, optionally within one category or verified-only. Each row says whether its MRR is verified or self-reported.

tools.name: compare_startups
tools.description: Compare the current MRR and growth of 2 to 5 startups side by side, with the verification status of each figure.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories on ShowMRR with how many startups each has and how many of those have verified MRR.
